title: Chapter 822
text:
More than thirty battleships built with Star System technology faced off against the mechanical life forms and troops that were buffed by Han Xiao's Mechanical Force through the (Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission Channel).

The battle ended in an instant. This Great Cosmos Corps fleet was completely annihilated, and the main ship was blown up into a firework in space.

Before the main ship exploded, Kikiga saw that the situation was not good and tried to escape in an escape pod in panic. However, the escape pod was destroyed by the Crimson Flames halfway. He originally wanted to break out of the encirclement with his extraordinary strength, but Psionic Prime kicked him to the brink of death and captured him.

Psionic Prime and the others obeyed the order faithfully. Apart from destroying the battleships, they captured more than ten upper echelons, including Kikiga. As for the millions of Great Cosmos Corps soldiers, they were annihilated along with the spaceship.

Inside the spaceship, Kikiga and the operators were tied up by electromagnetic chains and fell to the ground. The shadow of the mechanical life forms covered everyone, making them so nervous that they almost could not breathe.

Everyone looked at the tall mechanical life forms around them in fear and trembled. The mechanical life forms did not have any expressions, so no one could tell what these metal life forms were thinking. They were terrified and did not know what they were going to do next.

However, Kikiga had a dazed expression. He still could not believe what had happened.

His powerful fleet had been destroyed by these strange creatures so easily?!

Furthermore, he was completely powerless in front of these monsters.

The Great Cosmos Corps respected the strong, and there were some Supers among them. However, these people did not have systematic Super knowledge, so every Super was an extremely rare existence in the Great Cosmos Corps. They took up many important positions, and Kikiga became the leader of a squad because of his outstanding combat ability.

He originally had a lot of confidence in his own strength, but this confidence was shattered by Psionic Prime's kick. His mentality collapsed, and he started to doubt his life.

What kind of monsters were these metal life forms? He had plundered everywhere, but he had never seen a life form like this.

"You — you … what are you?" Kikiga's teeth were chattering.

"I'm Psionic Prime, the first generation of Black Star's family, the leader of the mechanical army of the Black Star Corps," Psionic Prime slowly said. His emotionless electronic voice made everyone shudder.

"The Black Star Corps …" This was the second time Kikiga had heard that name today.

When he first heard it, he didn't think much of it and thought that it was just a bunch of natives. But now, his contempt had disappeared along with the fleet, leaving only panic and fear.

Kikiga swallowed. Who was this "Black Star Corps"? How could they be so powerful? He had never heard of this force before. He only felt that it was extremely mysterious.

Seeing Kikiga's face filled with fear and confusion, Psionic Prime tilted his head, raised his finger, and shot out a beam of light, forming a virtual screen in front of everyone.

On the screen, images and paragraphs of text scrolled by. They were all the deeds and experiences of the Black Star Corps.

Before the battle started, Philip had already hacked into the enemy's spaceship and recorded the language of the Great Cosmos Corps into the database. That was why they could communicate now. Other than the language, the information stored in this fleet was also packaged and copied. The other party's Virtual Technology was extremely clumsy and had no secrets in front of Philip. He could come and go as he pleased.

"This is …" As the mysterious veil of the Black Star Corps was lifted, Kikiga and the others gradually opened their mouths wide in shock. The origin of the Black Star Corps brought them an unparalleled shock. Their worldview shattered.

Godora, Dark-star, Bloodshed Land, Amethyst Civilization, Red Empire … There were so many organizations in the universe? How come they had never even heard of them?

Beyond Grade A? In Kikiga's impression, Atimo was already the strongest person in this universe. He could not imagine how someone could have strength that far exceeded Atimo's.

Kikiga originally imagined that Atimo would lead an army to take revenge for them. However, now that he saw the tip of the iceberg of the Black Star Corps, he only had one thought left.

Please don't come over!

…

"They captured the captives?"

Han Xiao, who was commanding a fleet to explore another resource planet, received Psionic Prime's message and immediately retrieved the copied information from Philip's database.

After taking a look, Han Xiao was stunned.

I knew it. There are no hidden Star System civilizations in this area. It turns out that it's those idiots from the Great Cosmos Corps. They actually have a team here … Han Xiao realized.

"I didn't expect the target of this hidden mission to be these people. They didn't meet the dynasty this time but met me instead … It seems like they're very unlucky." Han Xiaoxin chuckled.

The territory of the Great Cosmos Corps was mainly located in the center of the Garu Star Cluster. According to the normal exploration speed, it would take at least a few years for them to reach that location. However, they had met these people in advance.

After eliminating one of their fleets, the other party would definitely investigate to the end. Although these people would not be able to affect him or the dynasty, it was not his style to ignore them.

Han Xiao paced around with his hands behind his back. After pondering for a while, his eyes suddenly sparkled.

"That's right, these people have plundered many planets. They definitely have the information of these planets in their hands. Even if they destroy some of the planets, they will still be able to provide exploration points. This information is very valuable to the dynasty and can be considered a result."

If he obtained this information, the total exploration points of the main storyline mission would definitely skyrocket. Furthermore, this would be considered a dazzling result, and the dynasty would also reward him. It would show that his exploration was smoother than Bloodshed Land's.

"This is a pretty good opportunity." Han Xiao's eyes narrowed. Although the Great Cosmos Corps was extremely weak, the information they had accumulated was very useful.

He turned on his communicator and directly contacted the chief commander, Tarrokov, without Senico.

"Black Star, why are you looking for me?" Tarrokov was a little surprised. Normally, he only needed to discuss matters with Senico, but Han Xiao directly contacted him. Could there be something special?

"Chief Commander, I have made a new discovery." Han Xiao slowly said, "A few days ago, my army found a damaged beacon on Planet Pangurus. After repairing it, I followed the beacon and sent a team to contact an unfamiliar native organization …"

He then explained the information about the Great Cosmos Corps and emphasized, "According to the information, this organization lives by plundering and is active in the center of the Garu Star Cluster. They seem to have a lot of territories. The way I see it, the information they have on the planets will be of great help to our exploration."

"So, that's the case."

Tarrokov's eyes flashed, and he pondered for a while before nodding. "If you're not wrong, this will indeed allow us to obtain a large amount of information on the planets. This is not a small contribution. You went around Senico because you want me to allow you to start a war?"

Han Xiao did not comment.

In the dynasty's exploration rules, it was stated that they had to treat the natives peacefully. If they wanted to start a war with a Star System level native organization, they would need the approval of the dynasty. If they wiped out the natives without permission, they would incur the dynasty's displeasure. After all, the Star Field belonged to the dynasty, and their allies were only helping to mine.

Thus, if they wanted to wipe out the Great Cosmos Corps, they would need the chief commander's approval.

As for wiping out the Great Cosmos Corps, Han Xiao did not have any psychological burden. These people lived by plundering and had enslaved dozens of native races. They were essentially galactic pirates, and as a galactic pirate hunter, his hands were itchy the moment he saw one.

Tarrokov thought for a while before saying with a deep voice, "I will write an order and send it to the Black Star Corps to express that your operation is my idea. I will leave the matter of plundering the information to you guys. There is no need to keep these people alive."

"Okay." Han Xiao nodded.

"I will report the truth. The Black Star Corps found this information. This is your work, so the credit will naturally be yours." Tarrokov pursed his lips and gave a friendly signal.

After pausing for a while, Tarrokov suddenly changed the topic and said with deep meaning, "Of the three Star Clusters in the first phase, Renault is sandwiched in the middle. Its geographical location is superior, and it looks like it has the most resources. Thus, the upper echelons of the dynasty place the most importance on the development of the Renault Star Cluster."

Why are we suddenly talking about another Star Cluster? Isn't Renault the area that the Bloodshed Land is exploring? Han Xiao was stunned.

Tarrokov continued. "As for the Garu Star Cluster … because it has more desolate universe belts, the upper echelons of the dynasty have the lowest expectations of Garu. This is also the reason why so few people chose to explore Garu. However, if the exploration of the Garu Star Cluster is successful, it will be a surprise to the dynasty."

Han Xiaoxin understood. Tarrokov was revealing the direction of the dynasty and giving him a reminder.

The dynasty placed more importance on Renault, so they paid the most attention to Renault. The Bloodshed Land would need more results to satisfy their expectations. As for the Garu that he explored, as long as the results were not too bad, it would be a surprise. It would be easier for him to obtain credit and be recognized by the dynasty. There were pros and cons.

Seeing that Han Xiao was deep in thought, Tarrokov smiled and did not continue this topic. He purposely reminded Han Xiao not only to build a good relationship with Han Xiao but also to motivate the Black Star Corps. This was one of his jobs as the commander-in-chief.

[Beacon of Unknown Origin] completed!

You have received 3,000,000 EXP and 70 Individual Exploration Points.

You have received [Bold Explorer] Ability Fragment x1 (Two fragments are required to fuse them).

"With one fragment, at least I have a start. It's time to try and obtain the second fragment."

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. This was a pleasant surprise. Maple Moon's luck was really good.

At this time, the notification on the interface did not end.

You have triggered the faction mission [Annihilate the Great Cosmos Corps]!

Mission Introduction: The Great Cosmos Corps is a predator organization in the Garu Star Cluster. They have committed heinous crimes and have committed heinous crimes. The Black Star Corps is requested to annihilate this organization — Dynasty Exploration Army Commander-in-Chief Tarrokov.

Note: This mission is a sub-mission of [Flickering World] and will reward Exploration Points.

Note: This mission is a faction series mission. You can complete the following requirements in this mission.

Kill Enemies I: Kill 10 ordinary warriors of the Great Cosmos Corps. Reward: 750,000 EXP and 3 Exploration Points.

Kill Enemies II: Kill 10 elite warriors of the Great Cosmos Corps. Reward: 1,500,000 EXP and 6 Exploration Points.

Kill Enemies III: Kill 10 spaceship operators. Reward: 2,000,000 EXP and 9 Exploration Points.

Destroy Ship I: Destroy a guard battleship. Reward: 3,600,000 EXP and 12 Exploration Points.

…

Capture the King I: Kill 1 high-level combatant. Reward: 5,500,000 EXP and 24 Exploration Points.

Capture the King II: Kill 1 Big Boss. Reward: 7,000,000 EXP and 30 Exploration Points.

Capture the King III: Kill 'Great Emperor' Atimo. Reward: 22,000,000 EXP and 60 Exploration Points.

After the mission is completed, the rating will be based on the number of targets completed, and additional rewards will be given.

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. This faction mission was issued by the dynasty to the entire Black Star Corps, which meant that other than him, the other army players could accept it as well.

Han Xiao originally planned to send out his mechanical army to crush the Great Cosmos Corps, but he changed his mind at this time.

Since the players could accept this mission, he would let the players do it. It would not be a problem to spend more time. This Great Cosmos Corps was not that strong, so it was just right to let the players deal with it.

The average strength of the players was gradually increasing, so he might as well let the players destroy the Great Cosmos Corps alone. Other than the spaceships, he did not plan to let any of the army NPCs move together.

This was the first military operation that only the players were involved in!

This would enrich the exploration of the Flickering World for the players and give them a better experience. Compared to pure exploration, most of the players preferred combat.

The people of the Great Cosmos Corps were all walking EXP. Letting the players kill them would be like fertilizing the leeks. It was still the early stage of Version 3.0, and there were no max-level players yet.

Furthermore, players had to replenish their ammo in battle, and their equipment had to be repaired when their durability dropped. Repairs cost money, and even the smallest mosquito was meat. Furthermore, the number of players was so large that many a little makes a mickle, and sand makes a tower. The profit was not much worse than mining resource planets.

Han Xiao had never neglected the army's firearms business. He was making money from war.

Let the enemies gather together and take the initiative to attack. This will save some time …

Han Xiao contacted Philip and gave Psionic Prime some instructions.

…

Central area of the Garu Star Cluster, Great Cosmos Corps headquarters.

An adjutant hastily came to Atimo's seat and said with a trembling voice, "Y-Emperor, we have lost contact with Leader Kikiga's troops!"

A cold light flashed through Atimo's eyes, and he said with a deep voice, "What happened?"

"They … they planned to invade the location of the beacon, but they encountered the enemy's troops midway and were annihilated …" the adjutant said with a trembling voice. "Those enemies called themselves the Black Star Corps and sent us a message."

"Black Star Corps …" Atimo frowned. "What did they say?"

The adjutant turned on the device with trembling hands, opened the screen, and played the message.

Psionic Prime's figure appeared on the screen, and beside him was Kikiga, who was trembling on the ground.

"I am the leader of the mechanical army of the Black Star Corps, Psionic Prime. People of the Great Cosmos Corps, listen up. The Black Star Corps will flatten all your territories, kill all your warriors, and take everything from you. Tell your leader, Atimo, that the army commander will drink from his skull."

As soon as he said that, Psionic Prime's arm turned into a sharp blade flickering with psionic light and slashed across Kikiga's neck.

Puchi!

Fresh blood spurted out, and Kikiga's head was separated from his body. His headless corpse fell to the ground and was still twitching.

Psionic Prime's tone was emotionless. "Prepare for war!"

Then, the screen turned black, and all the messages were played.

Atimo was originally looking at this video indifferently, but when Kikiga was beheaded right in front of him, his eyes flickered.

"Emperor, this is a provocation …" the adjutant carefully asked, "What should we do?"

Atimo slowly stood up.

"Gather all the fleets, all the combatants, and all the leaders …"

Atimo's tone was cold. "I'll go personally this time!"

"They want war, so I'll give them war!"

…

[Beacon of Unknown Origin] completed!

Maple Moon was in a dungeon with Pork Bun and the others, fighting a boss when the mission completion notification popped up on her interface. Her movements froze, and she was shocked.

"It's only been a few days, and the mission is already completed? I haven't even done anything yet!"

Maple Moon was shocked.

She had handed the beacon to the army as the mission suggested. Without a doubt, this was definitely the work of the faction.

Giving the beacon to the army was indeed the right decision.

"Don't just stand there, quickly control the field!" Pork Bun was being swung around by the boss not far away, and his teammates were sent flying one after another.

Maple Moon turned a blind eye to it and was immersed in her own thoughts.

She had thought about it for the past few days. This mission only required her to come into contact with an unknown organization, so there would definitely be more to it. She immediately opened the faction mission list, and her eyes sparkled.

As expected, there was indeed a follow-up mission, and it was a large-scale side mission issued by the dynasty!

"Great Cosmos Corps, such a chuunibyou name … So, it's a raider organization. The mission requirement is to eliminate this organization. Looks like it's a group mission. There will definitely be many people participating."

Maple Moon pondered.

"Help … me … ah …" The boss pressed Pork Bun to the ground and punched his face again and again. Pork Bun could only shout one word each time when the boss stopped punching, and his cries for help were very rhythmic.

With the last bit of health gone, Pork Bun turned into a beam of white light and died.

Maple Moon came back to her senses, raised her head, and threw out a bunch of compressed orbs.

A large number of mechanical creations drowned the Boss. Not long after, the Boss with only half of its HP left was killed by Maple Moon, who displayed her prowess.

After playing three versions, she realized that she was quite talented in this area, and her PK skills were getting better and better. Furthermore, this version was the strongest period for the Mechanic class, so it was much easier to clear maps. Mechanics above level 100 were welcomed by most dungeon teams, and she was definitely the thigh of Pork Bun's team.

Everyone exited the dungeon and returned to the army's battleship.

"Why did you get distracted?" Pork Bun had a bitter look on his face. "I didn't need to use one revival."

"Look at the faction mission."

Pork Bun opened the faction interface in confusion and was overjoyed when he saw the mission [Eliminate the Great Cosmos Corps].

He then opened the forums and realized that the army players were already cheering on the forums.

Although the exploration of the main storyline mission was full of unknowns and was quite interesting, the players spent most of their time in the spaceship, so there were very few fighter jets.

Most of the players were very itchy and could only fight in the dungeons. Now that they finally had a chance to fight in the main storyline mission, all the army players were excited.

Wiping out a force sounded like a big mission.
